steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ with Vendor A and Vendor B bids.
Enable quantity splitting across vendors as required by the case.
Enable eRFX project behavior required by the setup.
Open the awarding screen for the two-bid closed event.
Allocate 6 units of the line to Vendor B.
Allocate the remaining 4 units to Vendor A.
Verify both vendors are awarded and the split total is ₹940 (6×90 + 4×100).
Create the award proposal from the completed split allocation.
Complete any mandatory proposal fields before submission.
Submit the proposal to finalize the award.
Verify the award proposal was submitted successfully.
Complete the downstream award process and create one purchase order per awarded vendor.
Verify the two awarded vendors result in two purchase-order lines across the created POs.
Open the History tab where completed or closed events are listed.
Verify this prepared event appears in History after the award and PO creation.
